definitions.gloss: remote control; remote operation; remote access
definitions.explanation: Controlling or operating a device, system, or machine from a distance, either through physical remote controls or via network connections.

examples.japanese: ⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{遠隔操作|えんかくそうさ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ロボット→ロボット：06404_robotto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{遠隔操作|えんかくそうさ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{動|うご}かせます→動く：00904_ugoku⟧。
examples.english: This robot can be operated by remote control.

examples.japanese: {遠隔操作|えんかくそうさ}⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦サポート→サポート：07776_sapooto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧で、⟦{現地|げんち}→現地：13502_genchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}かなくて→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解決|かいけつ}→解決：00136_kaiketsu⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to remote support, we were able to solve the problem without going on-site.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{遠隔|えんかく}→遠隔：14381_enkaku⟧ (remote, distant) and ⟦{操作|そうさ}→操作：03316_sousa⟧ (operation, control). Covers both physical remote control of devices and digital remote access to computers and systems.

USAGE:
Increasingly common in modern contexts — from IT support and remote desktop access to drone operation and smart home technology. Can be used as a suru verb: {遠隔操作|えんかくそうさ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to operate remotely).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遠隔操作|えんかくそうさ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to operate remotely
- {遠隔操作|えんかくそうさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{可能|かのう}→可能：00175_kanou⟧ — remote operation is possible
- {遠隔操作|えんかくそうさ}⟦ソフト→ソフト：01532_sofuto⟧ — remote access software
- {遠隔操作|えんかくそうさ}⟦ロボット→ロボット：06404_robotto⟧ — remotely operated robot

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦リモコン→リモコン：05284_rimokon⟧ — remote control (the handheld device)
- ⟦{遠隔|えんかく}→遠隔：14381_enkaku⟧ — remote, distant (the prefix alone)
- ⟦リモート→リモート：04743_rimooto⟧⟦アクセス→アクセス：10696_akusesu⟧ — remote access (IT loanword)
